description: Surfaced during specled_-6v6 verification: store_test.exs read_status tests place artifacts directly in System.tmp_dir!(), so they share the machine-global $TMPDIR/last_run.status sidecar (store.ex:265 resolves <dirname(path)>/last_run.status). A stale leftover from an earlier session made 'read_status/1 returns {:refused, :not_found}' (store_test.exs:266) fail on a dirty machine; CI is immune (fresh TMPDIR per run). Fix: give those tests a unique temp dir each. Not part of epic specled_-q6l.

comments.text: Review F14 (2026-07-24) found the same pattern in the NEW Store.load/1 test setup added by specled_-q6l.1 (writes/deletes the global last_run.status sidecar under async:true) — include that describe block when unique-diring.

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: partially_done   EFFORT: trivial

== MANDATE AS ADMITTED (implement THIS, not the original description) ==
Single edit, test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs, the `describe "load/1"` setup at lines 404-412. Replace with the same private-directory shape already used by the sibling blocks at :159-167 and :331-341:

    setup do
      # Same isolation as the read_status/1 setup above: write_v2 drops the
      # last_run.status sidecar in dirname(path), so the artifact needs a
      # test-private directory or the sidecar becomes machine-global shared
      # state (specled_-26g).
      tmp_dir =
        Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "store_load_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")

      File.mkdir_p!(tmp_dir)
      tmp_path = Path.join(tmp_dir, "per_test.coverdata")

      on_exit(fn -> File.rm_rf!(tmp_dir) end)

      {:ok, path: tmp_path}
    end

End state: no test in the repo writes or deletes `System.tmp_dir!()/last_run.status`. No test bodies need changing — `refute File.exists?(path)` at store_test.exs:431 still holds because `mkdir_p!` creates only the directory, not `per_test.coverdata`; the three tests that call `File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(path))` (store_test.exs:445, 452, 459) remain correct (idempotent). Then `mix format --check-formatted` and `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs`.

Optionally also update the ticket-reference comments at store_test.exs:161 and :334, which cite specled_-ind rather than specled_-26g — cosmetic, not required.

== EVIDENCE ==
The ticket BODY's mandate is already satisfied in this tree; the ticket COMMENT's (Review F14) mandate is not.

DONE — `describe "read_status/1"` is already unique-dired, test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs:327-343:
```
  describe "read_status/1" do
    @describetag spec: ["specled.coverage_capture.store_v2_envelope"]

    setup do
      # Same isolation as the write_v2 setup above: the last_run.status
      # sidecar lands in dirname(path), so the artifact needs a test-private
      # directory or the sidecar becomes machine-global shared state
      # (specled_-ind).
      tmp_dir =
        Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "store_status_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")

      File.mkdir_p!(tmp_dir)
      tmp_path = Path.join(tmp_dir, "per_test.coverdata")

      on_exit(fn -> File.rm_rf!(tmp_dir) end)
```
`git log -L 289,310:test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs main` shows this landed in 9ce640e6 ("feat(specled_-epl): flake diagnostics — release 0.6.0 (#16)"), i.e. ON MAIN, before the td7 branch. So the ticket's factual premise ("store_test.exs read_status tests place artifacts directly in System.tmp_dir!()", "store_test.exs:266") is FALSE in this tree — that test is now at :378 inside a private dir. The `describe "v2 envelope round trip"` setup (store_test.exs:150-168) is likewise already unique-dired.

NOT DONE — the F14 comment's target, `describe "load/1"`, test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs:397-412 (file is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, store_test.exs:2):
```
  describe "load/1" do
    ...
    setup do
      tmp_path =
        Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "store_load_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}.coverdata")

      on_exit(fn ->
        File.rm_rf!(tmp_path)
        File.rm_rf!(Path.join(Path.dirname(tmp_path), "last_run.status"))
      end)

      {:ok, path: tmp_path}
    end
```
This is exactly the flat-in-$TMPDIR shape the ticket exists to remove: its first test calls `Store.write_v2(envelope, path)` (store_test.exs:418), and lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex:371 `defp status_path(artifact_path), do: Path.join(Path.dirname(artifact_path), @status_filename)` with `@status_filename "last_run.status"` (store.ex:109) means that write lands the sidecar at `$TMPDIR/last_run.status` (write_v2 calls `write_status(path, ...)` on both the success and the `{:error, :empty_files}` refusal branch, store.ex:205/210). The `on_exit` then `File.rm_rf!`s that machine-global path.

Scope check — no other site remains: `grep -rn "last_run.status" lib test` returns only lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex (103/109/192/281), store_test.exs:157 and :331 (the two already-fixed comments), :388 (hostile-sidecar test, inside the isolated read_status dir), and :409 (the unfixed load/1 on_exit). The other write_v2 caller test, test/mix/tasks/spec_cover_test_test.exs:62/76/90/272, writes under `tmp_dir!("specled_cover_freshness")` (spec_cover_test_test.exs:29-32), a private root — safe.

== RISK NOTES ==
Realization hash: NO risk. .spec/realization_hashes.json has exactly one top-level key, "api_boundary" (verified: `json.load(...).keys() == ['api_boundary']`), and contains no test/ paths and no store_test entries — a test-setup edit cannot move a hash.

Branch guard / impacted set: test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs IS listed as a realization file of subject specled.coverage_capture (.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:109), so this edit pulls specled.coverage_capture into branch-guard's impacted set and its verifications must pass. That subject is already impacted on this PR by specled_-npo (edits coverage_capture.spec.md envelope_meta) and specled_-xkn.1/-xkn.2, so it costs nothing marginal. No spec requirement id is edited by this ticket; the `@describetag spec:` list on the load/1 block (store_test.exs:398-401) must be left byte-identical so tagged-test consistency is unaffected.

Same-file conflict — specled_-xkn.1: it flips `Store.safe_decode/2`'s default to fail-closed in lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex AND adds positive regression guards for the read_v2 carve-out, which will almost certainly add tests to this same store_test.exs, plausibly inside or adjacent to the `describe "load/1"` and `describe "v2 envelope round trip"` blocks. Land 26g FIRST (it is a pure setup-block replacement, trivial to rebase under) or have xkn.1 append its new tests below :464.

Policy conflict — specled_-ehv: it is deciding the repo-wide policy on `System.tmp_dir!()` + `System.unique_integer/1` test roots and explicitly proposes `SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0` (lib/specled_ex/temp_name.ex:18) as the replacement suffix. If ehv lands option 2 or 3 on the same PR, 26g's new `tmp_dir` should mint its suffix with `SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix()` instead of `System.unique_integer([:positive])` so the two do not disagree in the same file. Coordinate the suffix choice with ehv before writing; otherwise default to `System.unique_integer([:positive])` to match the two existing sibling setups.

No hard dependency: 26g can land independently and correctly with either suffix. Non-flaky gate — the fix removes a flake source rather than adding one.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate, which SUPERSEDES this ticket's description
(the description's mandate is already satisfied in the tree; the Review-F14 comment's
is not).

## COHERENCE OVERRIDE — read before you copy the admission's code block
The admission comment was written BEFORE specled_-ehv landed. Its suggested setup uses
`System.unique_integer([:positive])` to name the new tmp root. specled_-ehv has since
amended `.spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md`, which now says
new tests allocating shared-tmp roots should reach for
`SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0`. This is a NEW allocation, so use the helper:

    Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "store_load_#{SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix()}")

Read that ADR on your base before writing the setup. Everything else in the admission's
code block (mkdir_p!, the per_test.coverdata path, the on_exit rm_rf!, the returned
`{:ok, path: tmp_path}`) stands.

## Allowed touches
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs` — the `describe "load/1"` setup block only,
  plus optionally the stale `specled_-ind` ticket-reference comments at ~:161 and ~:334.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex` — no production change.
- `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md` — specled_-npo already landed edits here; no
  spec change is required for this ticket.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches. This should be a ONE-FILE diff.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- Do NOT change any test BODY. The admission verified none need it: `refute
  File.exists?(path)` still holds because `mkdir_p!` creates only the directory, and the
  three tests calling `File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(path))` remain correct because
  mkdir_p! is idempotent. If you believe a body must change, stop and say so instead.
- Do not convert the other tmp roots in this file or elsewhere. The ADR's accepted-risk
  carve-out covers them; bulk conversion is explicitly rejected.
- No new dependencies.

## END STATE — prove it, do not assert it
No test in the repo writes or deletes `System.tmp_dir!()/last_run.status`. Demonstrate
that with a repo-wide search in your completion record, not by assertion.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs`
3. `mix format --check-formatted`
4. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
5. `git diff --name-only` should list exactly one file.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator owns
whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.
